SSR gain-control equations were cross-checked against oxideav-aac at commit
5e71c7556f4b7691bbf8aa7306331e8fb5976ef1 (https://github.com/Sec-ant/oxideav-aac).
The TTPlayer adaptation uses bounded C arrays and the FAAD2 filterbank.
